query:
SELECT ec.id as cat_id, ec.name as cat_name, ec.slug as cat_slug,
       es.id as sub_id, es.name as sub_name, es.slug as sub_slug
FROM equipment_categories ec
LEFT JOIN equipment_sub_categories es ON es.category_id = ec.id
ORDER BY ec.sort_order, es.sort_order;
